author: nickyeow

english.text: He gets tired easily.

jyutping: keoi5 hou2 ji6 gui6。

author: nickyeow

english.text: As soon as I get paid I will pay you back.

jyutping: ngo5 jat1 sau1 dou2 cin4 zau6 zik1 hak1 waan4 cin2 bei2 nei5。
text: 我一收到錢就即刻還錢俾你。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He is too young to go there alone.

jyutping: keoi5 zung6 sai3，m4 jing1 goi1 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3 jan4 heoi3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We often compare Japan with Britain.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 dou1 lo2 jing1 gwok3 tung4 jat6 bun2 lai4 bei2。
text: 我哋成日都攞英國同日本嚟比。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I want to tell you a strange thing.

jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 gong2 gin6 gwaai3 si6 bei2 nei5 teng1。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The film was not what I had thought it was.

jyutping: tou3 hei3 tung4 ngo5 soeng2 zoeng6 zung1 zaang1 hou2 jyun5。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Why did you tear the cloth instead of cutting it with scissors?

author: nickyeow

english.text: When and where did you come to know her?

jyutping: nei5 hai6 gei2 si4 tung4 maai4 hai2 bin1 dou6 sik1 keoi5 gaa3？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Though he knew the truth, he told us nothing.

jyutping: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 zi1 dou3 go3 zan1 soeng3，daan6 hai6 zau6 mat1 dou1 mou5 tung4 ngo5 dei6 gong2。

author: kaenif

english.text: Come and see me when it is convenient for you.

jyutping: nei5 fong1 bin6 ge3 si4 hau6 lai4 gin3 ngo5 aa1。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't make any noise or you'll scare the birds away.

jyutping: m4 hou2 cou4 aa3，wui5 haak3 zau2 di1 zoek3 zai2 gaa3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I want to cry.

jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 haam3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: How old do you think she is?

jyutping: nei5 waa2 keoi5 gei2 do1 seoi3 aa1 naa4？

jyutping: ngo5 mou5 nam2 gwo3 jyun4 loi4 aap3 zeoi2 sau3 hai6 saang1 daan2 ge3。

english.text: Where did she park?

jyutping: keoi5 paak3 zo2 gaa3 ce1 hai2 bin1 aa3？

english.text: What do you want to find?

english.text: Enos became the first chimp to orbit the earth on November 29, 1961, aboard a Mercury Atlas rocket. Although the mission plan originally called for three orbits, due to a malfunctioning thruster and other technical difficulties, flight controllers were forced to terminate Enos' flight after two orbits. Enos landed in the recovery area and was picked up 75 minutes after splashdown. He was found to be in good overall condition.

text: 伊諾斯喺1961年11月29號成為咗第一隻喺水星阿特拉斯火箭上轉地球軌道嘅黑猩猩。雖然任務計劃原本要求三個軌道，但係由於推進器發生故障同其他技術困難，飛行控制員被迫終止伊諾斯嘅飛行喺兩次軌道之後，伊諾斯降落喺復原區，並喺潑水後75分鐘被拎起。

english.text: A boy who, on his way from one classroom to another, from the dayroom to the cricket field, and the library to the chapel, has always before him the silent grey-brown witnesses of continuity and tradition, cannot help thinking often consciously, and unconsciously times without number: “all this was going on two hundred years ago and, without any very considerable alteration, it will be going on two hundred hence.”

jyutping: jat1 go3 naam4 zai2，hai2 jau4 jat1 go3 fo3 sat1 heoi3 dou3 ling6 jat1 go3 fo3 sat1，jau4 jat6 gaan1 sat1 heoi3 baan2 kau4 coeng4，jau4 tou4 syu1 gun2 heoi3 gaau3 tong4 ge3 lou6 soeng6，keoi5 min6 cin4 jat1 zik6 dou1 hai6 lin4 zuk6 sing3 tung4 cyun4 tung2 ge3 mou4 sing1 fui1 fe1 sik1 gin3 zing3 ze2，keoi5 jan2 m4 zyu6 seng4 jat6 zi6 gok3 gam2 nam2，ji4 ce2 mou4 ji3 sik1 dei6 mou4 sou3 ci3：「so2 jau5 ni1 di1 dou1 hai6 hai2 loeng5 baak3 nin4 cin4 faat3 sang1 gan2，ji4 jyu4 gwo2 mou5 jam6 ho4 fei1 soeng4 daai6 ge3 goi2 bin3，zau6 wui6 hai2 loeng5 baak3 nin4 hau6 faat3 sang1。」
text: 一個男仔，喺由一個課室去到另一個課室，由日間室去板球場，由圖書館去教堂嘅路上，佢面前一直都係連續性同傳統嘅無聲灰啡色見證者，佢忍唔住成日自覺噉諗，而且 無意識地無數次：「所有呢啲都係喺兩百年前發生緊，而如果冇任何非常大嘅改變，就會喺兩百年後發生。」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The nature of the Germanic-Mediterranean dichotomy of English vocabulary seems still a novelty for many people, including my neighbours, the Wongs, who are multiracial from Fiji, once a British colony. The more educated an Anglophone is, the more acrolectal Mediterranean is the vocabulary. The less educated an Anglophone is, the more basilectal Germanic is the vocabulary. The late inventor, Buckminster Fuller, was very experimental in his English writing, as he concocted new-fangled words from Mediterranean and Germanic roots. He thought that using words only found in the dictionary was like living in a prison.

text: 英文詞彙嘅德語同地中海二分法嘅性質似乎對好多人嚟講仍然係一個新奇嘅事，包括我嘅鄰居，黃人，佢哋係來自斐濟嘅多種族，曾經係英國殖民地。巴克明斯特 · 富勒，喺佢嘅英文寫作上非常有實驗性，因為佢用地中海同日耳曼語嘅根源炮製出新嘅詞語。佢覺得用只係喺字典入面搵到嘅詞語就好似住喺監獄噉。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: They went home together, Tess holding one arm of her father, and Mrs Durbeyfield the other. He had, in truth, drunk very little—not a fourth of the quantity which a systematic tippler could carry to church on a Sunday afternoon without a hitch in his eastings or genuflections; but the weakness of Sir John's constitution made mountains of his petty sins in this kind. On reaching the fresh air he was sufficiently unsteady to incline the row of three at one moment as if they were marching to London, and at another as if they were marching to Bath—which produced a comical effect, frequent enough in families on nocturnal homegoings; and, like most comical effects, not quite so comic after all.

text: 佢哋一齊返屋企，泰絲抱住佢爸爸嘅一隻手臂，而杜比菲爾德太太另一隻手臂，佢真係飲咗好少酒 —— 唔夠一個有系統嘅飲酒者喺星期日嘅下晝可以無阻噉喺佢嘅東面或者跪低嘅時候帶去教堂嘅四分一如果佢哋遊行去倫敦，而喺另一個時候，就好似佢哋遊行去巴斯咁 —— 呢個產生咗一個搞笑嘅效果，喺夜晚返屋企嘅家庭入面夠頻繁；同埋，就好似大部分嘅搞笑效果噉，畢竟唔係咁搞笑。
